complete_examples.text: The key matrices in depicting vehicle-track interaction are established with satisfaction of wheel-rail displacement complementarity by geometrical constraint equations and the wheel-rail force equilibrium by energy variational principle.

For example, when using uncoupling approaches to establish the dynamic model, the vehicle and the tracks are separately constructed and connected by wheel-rail force equilibrium equations ex-plicitly, in which the wheel-rail elastic compression is calculated based on Hertzian contact theory.
